scripts.build: pnpm --filter @lrc/contracts build && pnpm --filter @lrc/qc build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lrc/contracts build && pnpm --filter @lrc/qc build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @lrc/contracts build && pnpm --filter @lrc/qc build && tsx --test src/**/*.test.ts
